entries.title: Frontier Foundry is now on games.radgh.com
items: Survey a star system, pick a landing site and set down with four builders and a crate of plate.
Scan for what lies under the ground, then mine it, refine it and build a factory around shared store pools. Trucks carry goods between clusters.
A full research tree, a world map of the planet, an orbit screen for satellites and the rocket, and a quest board.
The smoke and noise you make draw waves of local wildlife, so build turrets and walls before it gets loud.
Fill the rocket's hold and leave for the next world, where something new will break your habits.
This list: press What's new on the title screen or in the menu to see what changed.
